moods.mood_description: A fragile ceasefire ends active combat, but no true winner is declared
Lin, Zahra, Thorne, and Sharifi reach the limits of what they can control or survive
Reinforce that ordinary people bear the real archive of war
Answer the fates of major characters without false consolation
The strait reopens, yet the world is forever changed
Survivors reflect on the human, economic, and geopolitical cost
A single tanker passes at sunrise, escorted by wary warships, hinting at a tense new normal
